product_metadata.title: Genexice Stainless Steel Shower Caddy with Rotate & Lock Suction Cups
features: Suction will NOT work on stone, wood, sanded tile, porcelain, marble, dry wall & any surface that is bumpy, porous or matte finished

*Note: The surface of wall has to be very clean, free of dust for the suction cup to stay on wall. Surface of glass or mirror works better. Adding some water will help the suction cup stick on surface.
Suction works best on ceramic tile, glass, mirror, granite, stainless steel, acrylic, laminate and any non-porous surface with glossy finish
